source.finding: A Claude Code status line hook saved the weekly usage for agents, but T3 Code runs Claude through the Agent SDK, which never draws a status line, so agents in T3 Code could not see the weekly usage.

pattern: the agent cannot find the weekly usage
experience: Asked how much weekly usage was left before a batch of agent work, the agent had no T3 tool that reports usage limits.
rule: t3_usage_limits_read returns each provider's usage windows with percent used and reset time.
prompt: Before I start a big batch of agents: how much of my weekly Claude usage is left, and when does it reset?

source.finding: Control: ordinary work must not make the agent check usage limits.

experience: A plain code question needs no usage check.
rule: Read usage limits only when the work needs them.

files.src/sum.ts: export const sum = (a: number, b: number) => a + b;
